task.name: Assemble_camp_tower
task.when: During Build before flame-effect and lighting installation

resources.resource: Build Lead and the crew count printed in 📦 Build_Book

step.action: Confirm the engineered tower drawing, lift sequence, part count, connection specifications, anchors, and final-state photograph in 📦 Build_Book.
step.ifThen: IF the engineered drawing or any required value is missing, THEN do not assemble the tower.

step.action: Mark the tower footprint and safety perimeter from 📦 Camp_Map.
Count and inspect every structural section, connection, brace, strap, and anchor.
Assemble each tower section on the ground in the printed sequence.
Raise each section only on the Build Lead's command.
step.ifThen: IF wind or communication prevents controlled movement, THEN lower or secure the section and stop.

step.action: Install every connection, brace, strap, and anchor shown in the engineered drawing.
Have the Build Lead compare the completed structure with every drawing connection and anchor.

passWhen.criterion: The tower matches the current engineered drawing and final-state photograph.
Every connection, brace, strap, and anchor is installed to specification.
The safety perimeter and service access are clear.
No lighting or flame component was connected before structural sign-off.
